clue.text: Cast in powerful position reportedly taking break

indicators.note: what is reported is passed on by word of mouth, so the word before it is taken by its sound

parts.note: a throne is the seat of royal power
someone taking a break is away, on holiday

explanation.surface: An actor is cast in the role of someone powerful who takes a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast' looks like a theatrical casting, but it is the definition, in its sense of tossed aside.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast something off is to discard it, so something cast has been discarded or thrown out.

clue.text: Terrible boy regularly selected du Maurier novel

indicators.note: picking at regular intervals means taking every other letter of the words before it

parts.note: the first, third, fifth and every second letter after

explanation.surface: A dreadful lad is chosen to appear in a novel by du Maurier.
explanation.walkthrough: The novel is George du Maurier's 1894 bestseller, not one by his granddaughter Daphne.
explanation.definitionFit: Trilby is the 1894 novel by George du Maurier that introduced Svengali and gave its name to the hat.

clue.text: Average round? High point making eagle?

indicators.note: turning something round makes it face the other way, so the word before it is read backwards

parts.note: par is the average or normal level
a tor is a rocky hilltop

explanation.surface: A golfer asks whether an average round with a high point could yield an eagle.
explanation.walkthrough: Golf terms abound: par, round and eagle, but the eagle is the bird. The question mark flags it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle is one example of a bird of prey, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Iron used in wayward drive becomes futile enterprise

indicators.note: something used in another thing is placed inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: wild means erratic, off course
a goose is a tailor's heavy smoothing iron
to drive animals is to chase them

explanation.surface: A golfer using an iron after a wayward drive is engaged in a hopeless effort.
explanation.walkthrough: Iron and drive suggest golf; a goose is a tailor's iron, named for its curved handle.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a pointless pursuit of something unattainable, just as a futile enterprise achieves nothing.

clue.text: Poisoners taking in a pasta sauce for veggie

indicators.note: to take something in is to let it inside, so the following pieces sit within the first

parts.note: asps are venomous snakes
taken as written
ragù is an Italian meat sauce for pasta

explanation.surface: Poisoners lace a pasta sauce meant for a vegetarian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Veggie' suggests a vegetarian person, but here it is short for vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Veggie is informal for a vegetable, and this spear-shaped shoot is a familiar green one.

clue.text: Scotsman, in the East End, from Mennonite sect

indicators.note: Cockneys of London's East End famously drop the aspirate at the start of a word

parts.note: Hamish is a typically Scottish first name

explanation.surface: A Scot living in London's East End came from a Mennonite community.
explanation.walkthrough: Hamish loses his H as a Cockney would say it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Amish are a conservative Anabaptist group that split from the Mennonites in the 1690s.

clue.text: Mirror to both sides of southern recess

indicators.note: something on both sides of another flanks it, so it wraps around the following letter

parts.note: to ape is to copy or mimic
S is the abbreviation for southern

explanation.surface: A mirror hangs on both sides of a recess in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is a semicircular recess, typically at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Ask one fellow: who rules the waves?

parts.note: to pose a question is to ask it
Roman numeral one
a don is a university fellow

explanation.surface: Someone asks a fellow who it is that rules the waves, as in the song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rule, Britannia' suggests Britain, but the ruler of the waves is a god.
explanation.definitionFit: Poseidon was the Greek god of the sea, ruler of the oceans and their waves.

clue.text: Maybe diner eating egg won't require a long time

indicators.note: what is not required is left out, so the following letter is dropped
what is eaten goes inside, so the next piece is placed within the first

parts.note: a diner is one kind of eatery, hence maybe
a nit is the egg of a louse
the letter removed

explanation.surface: A diner eating an egg dish won't need a long wait.
explanation.walkthrough: The eatery takes in the louse egg and then sheds its A.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternity is endless time, used hyperbolically for any very long wait.

clue.text: Weary girls went swimming freestyle

parts.note: all in means exhausted

indicators.note: things swimming move about freely, so these letters drift into a new order

parts.note: letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Tired girls went for a freestyle swim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Freestyle' and 'swimming' paint a pool, but freestyle is the name of a wrestling style.
explanation.definitionFit: All-in wrestling is a style with few restrictions on holds, also called freestyle wrestling.

clue.text: Mischievous duo taking female out for drive

indicators.note: taking something out removes it, so the named letter is dropped

parts.note: an imp and an elf are a pair of mischievous sprites
F is the abbreviation for female

explanation.surface: Two pranksters take a woman out for a drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drive' looks like a car outing, but it is a verb meaning to push.
explanation.definitionFit: To impel is to urge or force forward, as to drive does.

clue.text: A misfortune being confined to unfashionable bed

indicators.note: what is confined is shut inside, so the first pieces sit within the last

parts.note: passé means out of fashion
an ill is a misfortune or trouble
taken as written

explanation.surface: Bad luck has someone stuck on an old-fashioned bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A paillasse is a straw-filled mattress, a crude bed.

clue.text: Saw man chasing second-rate online contributor

indicators.note: one thing chasing another runs behind it, so the piece before this word is placed after the piece following it

parts.note: B grade is second class
a logger saws trees

explanation.surface: A man with a saw pursues a mediocre internet poster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chasing' means the saw man follows the grade letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A blogger writes posts for a website, contributing content online.

clue.text: West Indian taking Chinese across first island?

indicators.note: spreading across something covers it on both sides, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: the Han are the majority Chinese people
an ait is a small river island; styled like a monarch, the first would be Ait I

explanation.surface: A Caribbean traveller takes a Chinese companion over to the first island they reach.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the joke: the island is numbered like a king, Ait the First.
explanation.definitionFit: Haiti is a Caribbean nation in the West Indies, so a native of it is a West Indian.

clue.text: Unduly protracted, like The Sword in the Stone?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: going on far too long

definitions.text: like The Sword in the Stone?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, playful: the legendary blade was pulled from its rock only after many had failed

explanation.walkthrough: In Arthurian legend the sword stuck fast in the stone until young Arthur extracted it; read literally, the phrase says it was long in the drawing.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for something prolonged to tedium, and read word by word describes a sword taking ages to be pulled.

clue.text: Game girl brought up in a mythical land

parts.note: RU is rugby union
a girl's name

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing something up reads it from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sporty girl was raised in a land of legend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brought up' looks like upbringing, but it turns only the little word after the girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruritania is the fictional Central European kingdom of Anthony Hope's The Prisoner of Zenda, an imaginary country.

clue.text: Go to protect Kamala, ousting a Republican hypocrite?

indicators.note: to protect something is to surround it, so the next piece goes inside

parts.note: to go is a euphemism for to urinate

indicators.note: to oust is to expel, so the named letter is taken away

parts.note: Kamala Harris, US Vice-President and 2024 presidential candidate
R abbreviates Republican

explanation.surface: A political call to defend Kamala Harris by pushing out a two-faced Republican.
explanation.walkthrough: The Democrat's surname loses one of its two Rs inside a toilet word.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Testament Pharisees were condemned as hypocrites, so the name became a byword for sanctimonious hypocrisy.

clue.text: City where small outlaw tucks into cheese

indicators.note: what tucks into something slips inside it

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
S is the abbreviation for small
to ban is to outlaw

explanation.surface: A city where a little bandit tucks into some cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucks into' suggests eating, but it signals insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: Brisbane is the capital of Queensland, Australia, and a major city.

clue.text: Doctor here? Let's try a medical hub

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the following letters are altered in order

parts.note: letters to be rearranged
more letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Looking for a doctor? Try a medical centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' reads as a physician but is a verb. Harley Street in London is famous for private medical practices.
explanation.definitionFit: Harley Street in central London is lined with private clinics and specialists, making it the capital's famed hub of medicine.

clue.text: Digger may use this phone number to ring bank

indicators.note: to ring something is to encircle it, so the next piece goes inside

parts.note: tel. is the abbreviation for telephone number
a bank is a row, as of keys or oars

explanation.surface: Someone digging uses a phone number to call the bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring' suggests a phone call, but it means surround.
explanation.definitionFit: A trowel is a small hand tool a gardener or archaeologist digs with.

clue.text: Handsome youth said no unfortunately

indicators.note: an unfortunate outcome has gone wrong, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A good-looking young man was regrettably turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: Adonis, the youth loved by Aphrodite, stands for any strikingly beautiful young man.

clue.text: Fruit went up, hiked at first by smallest amount

parts.note: rose means ascended

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of the word just before it

parts.note: the initial letter
one penny, 1p, the smallest sum of money, with 1 as I

explanation.surface: A price went up, raised at first by the tiniest margin.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests prices rising; the smallest amount is the coin 1p, read as IP.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosehip is the red fruit of the rose plant.

clue.text: Puff for short time

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a mo is a moment

explanation.surface: A quick drag on a cigarette.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Puff' suggests smoking, but it is a piece of flattering publicity.
explanation.definitionFit: A puff is a piece of exaggerated praise, as is a promo, a promotional advert.

clue.text: Did coach express disapproval? Nothing revolutionary

parts.note: tut is a sound of disapproval
O looks like zero
red stands for a communist revolutionary

explanation.surface: A coach clucked disapprovingly that nothing was revolutionary.
explanation.definitionFit: To tutor someone is to teach them privately, which is coaching them.

clue.text: Ship's cargo is pale blue cloth

indicators.note: cargo is carried in a ship's hold, so the next piece goes inside

parts.note: SS is steamship
wan means pale
down means feeling blue, depressed

explanation.surface: A ship is carrying pale blue fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pale blue' looks like one colour but splits into two separate words.
explanation.definitionFit: Swansdown is a soft, thick cotton fabric with a napped surface, so it is a cloth.

clue.text: Here Shanklin is a North American

parts.note: Shanklin is a resort on the Isle of Wight, abbreviated IOW
the article

explanation.surface: A North American person lives here in Shanklin.
explanation.walkthrough: Shanklin is a seaside town on the Isle of Wight, off England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: An Iowan comes from Iowa, a US state, so is a North American.

clue.text: Farewell from animals who don't bite in Elysium?

indicators.note: taking one thing from another subtracts it, so the first is removed from the second

parts.note: the Edentata are the toothless mammals: sloths, anteaters and armadillos
ta-ta is a casual goodbye

explanation.surface: Bidding goodbye to gentle, harmless creatures in paradise.
explanation.walkthrough: Edentata means toothless, the old zoological order of anteaters and sloths.
explanation.definitionFit: Elysium is the classical paradise and the garden of the Bible is another, so it is one example.

clue.text: Sea-girt on pole, Phoebus seen from east in city

indicators.note: in an across clue, seen from the east means read from right to left
girt means encircled, so the sea wraps round what follows

parts.note: taken as written
in cricket the on side is the leg side
N is the north pole
Phoebus Apollo was the sun god, Sol in Latin

explanation.surface: An island ringed by sea, sun god looking on from the east, lies in some city.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side is also called the leg side. Everything is built then read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Los Angeles is a major city in California.
